references.title: Never Ending Seasons 8.0 ft. Djantrix live
references.snippet: The 8th edition of the Never Ending Seasons beach gathering features a live performance by Djantrix from Digital Om Records. This outdoor night event includes a lineup with artists such as Fibre Stomp, Magic Hidden, Ravenine, Exact Opposite, Strobe, and Vrshaba. Attendees can enjoy the music and sea breeze in a casual atmosphere starting from sunset.

references.title: Crystal Clear Sounds 12.0 ft. Starlab Live
references.snippet: House of Chapora presents Crystal Clear Sounds 12.0, a night of electronic music featuring a headline performance by Starlab from Digital Om India. The lineup also includes Magic Hidden from Iran, Bastel from Germany, and Indian artists Zameer and Coco. This indoor nightlife event is tailored for friend groups looking for an immersive musical experience.

references.title: We Are Okay! Tour | Begum Live
references.snippet: A live musical performance by the band Begum as part of their 'We Are Okay!' tour. This nighttime concert takes place in a cocktail bar setting, offering an intimate atmosphere for fans of live music and indie performances.

references.title: DJ Chetas Live
references.snippet: An energetic nightlife experience featuring DJ Chetas, India's celebrated Bollywood DJ. The event features Bollywood commercial mashups and party hits in a nightclub setting. Premium VIP tables and luxury experiences are available for groups looking for high-energy dance music.

references.title: Madoc
references.snippet: An electrifying night at a nightclub featuring a live performance by MADOC. The event promises a dynamic sound experience with powerful beats and infectious rhythms, creating an immersive atmosphere for music lovers. This high-energy performance is designed for a nighttime crowd looking for vibrant nightlife.

references.title: Naadrang
references.snippet: Naadrang is an evocative classical music concert by Sandeep Ranade, a distinguished disciple of Pandit Jasraj Ji. Naadrang is thoughtfully curated musical experience that beautifully blends the richness of classical hindustani banish in modern format with musical expressions, making it an enriching cultural program for music lovers of all age groups.

references.title: Brigado Crew
references.snippet: A nighttime indoor event at a lounge featuring the music group Brigado Crew. This casual event is designed for groups of friends and is for an adult audience.

references.title: GOA SUNSPLASH
references.snippet: A vibrant reggae music festival and cultural event held at a resort hotel. This outdoor gathering celebrates the modern popular music of Jamaica and features a variety of music shows. It is a kid-friendly event suitable for friend groups looking to enjoy electronic and reggae music in a coastal setting.
